newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed, trading cautious.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed, trading cautious.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at noon session with a firmer Tokyo market aiding sheet rubber, but dealing remained slow ahead of the weekend.
"It is another quiet morning...but there was some covering among sheet grades by local dealers," a dealer said.

"Local prices are almost at par with that in Indonesia and Thailand," another dealer said. Consumers may come back to our market if the Thai government continues to intervene in its domestic rubber market. "This means that this will prop up their prices and make our raw materials cheaper," the dealer said.
